name: laya-dungeon
description: Auto-battler tatico cujas decisoes do heroi sao tomadas pelo modelo Laya rodando local em ONNX Runtime

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; import path from 'node:path'; const root = process.env.npm_config_local_prefix || process.env.INIT_CWD; spawn(process.execPath, [path.join(root, 'scripts', 'test.mjs')], { stdio: 'inherit' }).on('exit', (c, s) => process.exit(s ? 1 : (c ?? 1)));"
